//comments: eTamil has line comments only. The previous configuration declared a /* */ block comment, so Toggle Block Comment produced a lex error and commented-out regions were greyed as if the compiler would skip them.
//quotes: Double quotes only. eTamil has no single-quoted string, and the old grammar's '...' rule turned any stray apostrophe into a phantom string that swallowed the rest of the file.
//wordPattern: Tamil letters, ASCII letters, digits and underscore — the same shape the lexer accepts for an identifier, so double-click and word motions select கோப்பு_திற or varuvAy whole.
//indentationRules: eTamil writes the condition before the keyword — (x > 1) எனில் { — so the previous rules, which looked for எனில் followed by an open paren, could never fire. These match a line ending in an opening brace, which is the real signal in every block form the language has: எனில், இன்றேல், சுற்று, ஒவ்வொரு, செயல் and வழி.

onEnterRules.//: Continue a comment block while the author is mid-explanation. nUlakam documents nearly every செயல் that way.
